subject: english
stem: At last, the town has repaired the dangerous crossing. This overdue work will protect walkers. What is the attitude?
options: relieved but critical of the delay
certain the crossing was always safe

optionRationales.reason: relieved but critical of the delay：At last/overdue 批延誤，protect 肯定完成。
opposed to the repair：作者肯定 protect walkers。
certain the crossing was always safe：dangerous 與此相反。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「評價形容詞、副詞、選取細節與比較共同顯示的態度」可推出 relieved but critical of the delay；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 relieved but critical of the delay 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
